name: MTAC 416 452 MAX (MTAC, 452 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".791 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".406 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .416, Grains 452, Minimum Required Twist *1-13", Part Number MTAC 416 452 MAX, G1 BC .791 (A.B.), G7 BC .406 (A.B.), OAL 2.093", Bullet Projection 1.420"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.420".
